reason: I've never heard of this store and a paper cloud pendant at $360 looks like something I can find for a lot less on Amazon or AliExpress. The 10% off doesn't move me, since every store has a first-order code.
objection: Unknown store, and I'd be paying return shipping on a big fragile light if I change my mind. I can probably find the same light cheaper elsewhere.
would_change_my_mind: A side-by-side showing it's a different, better build than the cheap lookalikes, plus free returns and a price closer to $250 with a real stacking promo code.
